# Pingdom

Pingdom is a web performance monitoring service that allows users to monitor the uptime and performance of websites, servers, and applications.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pingdom/.

## Actions

- **Get Checks List**: Retrieve an overview list of all uptime checks with optional filters and pagination.
- **Get Contact Details**: Fetch detailed info of a specific pingdom alerting contact.
- **Get Contacts**: Retrieve all alerting contacts.
- **Get Credits**: Retrieve account credit and rate-limit information.
- **Get Maintenance Windows**: Retrieve a list of maintenance windows.
- **Get Pingdom Alert Actions**: Retrieve a list of alert actions for your pingdom account.
- **Get Probes**: Retrieve all pingdom probe servers.
- **Get Reference Data**: Retrieve pingdom reference data including time zones, states, probes, actions, roles, contact types, and integration types.
- **Get Single Check**: Perform a single pingdom check.
- **Get Team Details**: Fetch detailed information for a specific alerting team.
- **Get Teams**: Retrieve all alerting teams and their members.
- **Get TMS Transaction Checks List**: List all transaction (tms) checks.
- **List Maintenance Occurrences**: List maintenance occurrences.
